newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DISTRIGAZ IN GAS TRANSIT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: DISTRIGAZ IN GAS TRANSIT DEAL.

text.p: Belgian natural gas distributor Distrigaz said on Wednesday it had signed a deal with Britain's Conoco to carry one billion cubic metres of natural gas per year through the Distrigaz VTN/RTR network.
The agreement, the value of which was not disclosed, allows Conoco to fulfil a contract it signed last year to supply Germany's Wingas with British gas from October 1998.
The gas will come from Conoco's North Sea operations, pass through the British grid and the new Interconnector pipeline to the Belgian coats where it will enter the Distrigaz system.
This will carry the gas from Zeebrugge to Eynatten on the Belgian/German border and into the new Wingas-operated WEDAL pipeline for sale to the German market.
It is the third deal to date for the Distrigaz VTN/RTR network.
The total VTN/RTR transit capacity contracted so far represents more than 10 billion cubic metres a year, Distrigaz said.
